<html lang="en" style="--gp: 0.0000;"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Dear Your Family · Karthik & Nila's wedding</title>
<meta name="description" content="Karthik and Nila invite you to their wedding: reception on Saturday, 24 April 2027 and muhurtham on Sunday, 25 April 2027 in Chennai.">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1E1048">










<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/assets/flagship/hindu/sky.webp">
<link rel="preload" as="image" href="/assets/flagship/hindu/gopuram.webp">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,600&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Sky Lanterns: dusk sky, a gopuram you fly into, then colour blocks (silk, peacock, saffron, night) with one object each. */
:root{
  --dusk:#1E1048; --violet:#3B1A6E; --mag:#A3155F; --mag-d:#5E0A36; --silk:#7A0E45;
  --saffron:#F28C28; --gold:#F2C46B; --gold-2:#E2A640; --gold-d:#9A6A1F; --cream:#FFE9B8;
  --ivory:#FFF6E8; --peacock:#0C5E66; --peacock-d:#06343A; --turmeric:#F2A93B;
  --maroon:#5A0F2E; --night:#0B1030; --ink:#2B1630; --ink-2:#6B4A5E; --wa:#25D366; --on-wa:#10231A;
  --f-display:"Cormorant Garamond","Cormorant",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-ui:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --W:min(100vw,1040px,max(78vh,360px));
  --gl:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)); --gr:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  color-scheme:dark;
}
@supports (height:1svh){:root{--W:min(100vw,1040px,max(78svh,360px))}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:#120A2C url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='44' height='44'><circle cx='22' cy='22' r='1.4' fill='%23F2C46B' fill-opacity='.22'/><circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1' fill='%23F2C46B' fill-opacity='.14'/><circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1' fill='%23F2C46B' fill-opacity='.14'/></svg>");color:var(--ivory);font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
body.locked{overflow:hidden}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
button{font:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.inv{position:relative;width:min(100%,var(--W));margin-inline:auto;background:var(--dusk);box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow-x:clip}
.lbl{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.amp{font-style:italic;font-weight:400}
.sec{position:relative;padding:64px var(--gr) 64px var(--gl);display:grid;gap:14px;justify-items:center;text-align:center}
.sec h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,calc(var(--W) * .1),3.2rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05}
.lede{max-width:30ch;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.4}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.zari{height:14px;width:100%;background:
  linear-gradient(#9A6A1F,#9A6A1F) top/100% 2px no-repeat,
  linear-gradient(#9A6A1F,#9A6A1F) bottom/100% 2px no-repeat,
  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#F7D78C 0 5px,#C8932E 5px 7px,#F2C46B 7px 12px,#E2A640 12px 14px);
  position:relative;z-index:3}

/* progress thread and music */
.thread{position:fixed;top:0;left:50%;width:var(--W);height:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:60;pointer-events:none}
.thread i{display:block;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--saffron),var(--gold),var(--mag));transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--gp,0))}
.music{position:fixed;z-index:55;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);right:max(12px,calc((100vw - var(--W)) / 2 + 12px));width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(242,196,107,.6);background:rgba(30,16,72,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.music[hidden]{display:none}
.music .eq{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:16px}
.music .eq i{width:3px;height:30%;background:currentColor;border-radius:2px}
.music.on .eq i{animation:eq .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.music.on .eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.3s}.music.on .eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-.6s}.music.on .eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-.15s}
@keyframes eq{from{height:20%}to{height:100%}}

/* gate: light the first lantern */
.gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:#1B0E40;transition:opacity .9s ease .9s,visibility 0s linear 1.8s}
.gate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px;background:url("/assets/flagship/hindu/sky.webp") center 30%/cover;filter:blur(10px) brightness(.45) saturate(1.2)}
.gate[hidden]{display:none}
.gate > *{position:relative}
.gate .g-in{display:grid;gap:12px;justify-items:center;max-width:340px}
.gate .g-lan{width:96px;margin-bottom:6px;filter:brightness(.42) saturate(.6);transition:filter .7s ease,transform 2.2s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.2,1)}
.gate h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,12vw,3.6rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:#FFF3DC}
.gate .amp{color:var(--gold)}
.gate .lbl{color:#FFE2B0}
.gate .open{margin-top:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFE19A,#F2B347);color:#3A1405;font:700 1rem var(--f-ui);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(242,140,40,.45);animation:pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.gate .open svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.gate small{font:500 .8rem var(--f-ui);color:#D9C6E6}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(242,140,40,.35)}50%{box-shadow:0 10px 44px rgba(242,140,40,.75)}}
.gate.lit .g-lan{filter:brightness(1.15) saturate(1.1) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(255,180,70,.9));transform:translateY(-70vh) scale(.55)}
.gate.lit{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.gate.lit .open{animation:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}

/* pinned scenes */
.scene{position:relative;height:calc(var(--h) * 1vh);height:calc(var(--h) * 1svh)}
.stage{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden}
@supports (height:1dvh){.stage{height:100dvh}}
.layer{position:absolute;pointer-events:none}

/* lanterns */
.lns{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.ln{position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:105%;width:var(--s);animation:rise var(--d) linear var(--dl) infinite;will-change:transform}
.ln img{width:100%;animation:sway var(--sw) ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:50% 0}
.ln.g::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:72%;width:190%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,176,72,.42),rgba(255,140,40,0) 62%);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes rise{to{transform:translate3d(0,var(--dist,-140svh),0)}}
@keyframes sway{from{transform:rotate(-4deg) translateX(-6px)}to{transform:rotate(4deg) translateX(6px)}}
.calm-ln .ln{animation:none;top:var(--cy)}
.calm-ln .ln img{animation:none}

/* 1 · sky, gopuram, the dive */
#s-sky{--h:380;
  --rise:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .03) / .37),1);
  --z:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .46) / .42),1);
  --fl:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .8) / .14),1);
  --tt:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .05) / .2),1);
  --gw:min(calc(var(--W) * .96),60svh)}
#s-sky .stage{background:#2A1450}
.sky{inset:-6% -2% 0;background:url("/assets/flagship/hindu/sky.webp") center 35%/cover;transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * 5%)) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * .3));will-change:transform}
.lns.far{transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * -14svh)) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * .5));opacity:calc(1 - var(--z) * .8)}
.lns.mid{transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * -38svh)) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * 1.1));opacity:calc(1 - var(--z) * .6)}
.lns.near{z-index:5;transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * -90svh)) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * 2.2));opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--z) * 1.8),1)}
.title{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 9svh);display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:center;text-align:center;opacity:calc(1 - var(--tt));transform:translateY(calc(var(--tt) * -50px));z-index:6}
.dear{font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,calc(var(--W) * .062),2rem);color:#FFD98A;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(60,10,40,.7);padding-inline:.4em;max-width:100%}
.title .lbl{color:#FFE8C6;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(60,10,40,.8)}
.names{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(3.4rem,calc(var(--W) * .18),6.4rem);line-height:.9;color:#FFF4DE;letter-spacing:.01em;text-shadow:0 3px 26px rgba(110,12,60,.75),0 0 2px rgba(110,12,60,.5)}
.names .amp{display:block;font-size:.5em;line-height:1.15;color:var(--gold)}
.when{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.42em;color:#FFE8C6;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(60,10,40,.8);padding-left:.42em}
.gop{left:50%;bottom:0;width:var(--gw);z-index:3;transform-origin:50% 86%;
  transform:translate(-50%,calc((1 - var(--rise)) * 74%)) translateY(calc(var(--z) * (var(--gw) * .2033 - 50svh))) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * var(--z) * 6));will-change:transform}
.gop img{width:100%}
.gop .glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:86%;width:70%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,246,214,.95),rgba(255,206,110,.55) 32%,rgba(255,170,60,0) 68%);opacity:calc(.25 + var(--z) * 1.1);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes breathe{from{filter:brightness(.9)}to{filter:brightness(1.15)}}
.flash{inset:0;z-index:8;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#FFFBEF,#FFEFC8 55%,var(--cream));opacity:var(--fl)}
.hint{left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 18px);z-index:7;text-align:center;font:600 .68rem var(--f-ui);letter-spacing:.3em;color:#FFF0D2;opacity:calc(1 - var(--p,0) * 14);text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.hint i{display:block;margin:8px auto 0;width:12px;height:12px;border-right:2px solid currentColor;border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);animation:nudge 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nudge{50%{transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)}}

/* 2 · out of the light: the couple */
.couple{position:relative;z-index:2}
.couple-art{position:relative;aspect-ratio:2/3;overflow:hidden;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 68%,transparent 98%);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 68%,transparent 98%)}
.couple-art img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(calc(1.16 - var(--p,.5) * .16));transform-origin:50% 25%}
.couple-art::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:30%;background:linear-gradient(var(--cream),rgba(255,233,184,0));z-index:1}

/* 3 · silk: the invitation and the events */
.silk{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:-45%;padding:calc(45% + 10px) var(--gr) 70px var(--gl);display:grid;gap:14px;justify-items:center;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(58,2,30,.5),rgba(58,2,30,.62)),url("/assets/flagship/hindu/silk.webp") center top/100% auto repeat-y,var(--silk);color:#FFF1DC}
.silk .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.blessing{font-style:italic;font-size:1.25rem;color:#FFE3BC}
.parents{display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1.3}
.parents b{font-weight:600;color:#FFF6E6}
.parents span{font-style:italic;color:var(--gold)}
.gold-t{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF0C2 0%,#F2C46B 45%,#C98B2B 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.pair{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,calc(var(--W) * .16),5.4rem);line-height:.92;padding:4px .2em 8px;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(40,0,20,.55))}
.pair .amp{display:block;font-size:.5em;line-height:1.2}
.on-day{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FFE3BC}
.orn{width:150px;height:22px;color:var(--gold)}
.ev-head{margin-top:34px;display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:center}
.ev-head h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,calc(var(--W) * .1),3.2rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#FFF4E2}
.evs{display:grid;gap:44px;width:100%;margin-top:18px;justify-items:center}
@media (min-width:700px) and (min-height:720px){.evs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:start}}
.ev{display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:center;max-width:360px}
.medal{position:relative;width:min(80%,300px);aspect-ratio:640/958;margin-bottom:10px;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(30,0,15,.55))}
.medal .pic{position:absolute;top:14.6%;bottom:16.6%;left:10.9%;right:10.9%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;background:#3A0820}
.medal .pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.06)}
.medal .fr{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.ev .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.ev h3{font-size:2.3rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#FFF6E6}
.ev .day{font-weight:600;font-size:1.3rem}
.ev .where{font-style:italic;color:#FFE3BC;line-height:1.35;margin-top:4px}
.ev .note{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-size:.82rem;color:#F4D7DF;margin-top:6px}
.acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:46px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--gold);font:600 .92rem var(--f-ui);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.pill.solid{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFE3A0,#F0B54C);border-color:#F0B54C;color:#3A1405}
.pill svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}

/* 4 · the kolam leads to the venues */
#s-kolam{--h:230}
#s-kolam .stage{background:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 45%,#0F6E77 0%,#0A4E56 55%,#06343A 100%)}
#s-kolam .stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.18;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='120' height='120'><path d='M0 60 Q30 40 60 60 T120 60' fill='none' stroke='%23BFF3F0' stroke-width='1'/><path d='M0 90 Q30 70 60 90 T120 90' fill='none' stroke='%23BFF3F0' stroke-width='.6'/><path d='M0 30 Q30 10 60 30 T120 30' fill='none' stroke='%23BFF3F0' stroke-width='.6'/></svg>")}
.k-top{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 7svh);display:grid;gap:6px;justify-items:center;text-align:center}
.k-top .lbl{color:#BFF3F0}
.k-top h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,calc(var(--W) * .09),3rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#F4FFFD}
#kolam{left:50%;top:52%;width:min(calc(var(--W) * .86),58svh);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#kolam svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.35))}
#kolam path{fill:none;stroke:#FFF8EC;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
#kolam circle{fill:#FFF8EC;opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--p,0) * 9),1)}
.routes{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 5svh);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .82) * 9),1);transform:translateY(calc((1 - clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .82) * 9),1)) * 16px))}
.routes .pill{border-color:#BFF3F0;color:#F4FFFD;background:rgba(6,52,58,.55)}

/* 5 · meet the couple: a saffron room and the oonjal */
.meet{background:linear-gradient(#F6B24A,#EE9A2E);color:var(--maroon);padding-bottom:70px}
.meet .lbl{color:#7A1C0E}
.meet h2{color:#5A0F2E}
.room{position:relative;width:min(100%,520px);aspect-ratio:4/5;margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px}
.room .w{position:absolute;inset:0}
.room .ceil{background:#E58A24;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,84% 12%,16% 12%)}
.room .lw{background:#EF9930;clip-path:polygon(0 0,16% 12%,16% 80%,0 100%)}
.room .rw{background:#E98F29;clip-path:polygon(100% 0,100% 100%,84% 80%,84% 12%)}
.room .floor{background:linear-gradient(#C96A1A,#B85C14);clip-path:polygon(16% 80%,84% 80%,100% 100%,0 100%)}
.room .back{background:#F7B54E url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='36' height='36'><circle cx='18' cy='18' r='2.2' fill='%23FFF3D6' fill-opacity='.55'/><path d='M18 6 C24 12 24 24 18 30 C12 24 12 12 18 6Z' fill='none' stroke='%23FFF3D6' stroke-opacity='.35' stroke-width='1'/></svg>");clip-path:polygon(16% 12%,84% 12%,84% 80%,16% 80%)}
.room .rangoli{position:absolute;left:50%;top:91%;width:56%;aspect-ratio:3/1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#FFF3D6 0 18%,#A3155F 19% 34%,#FFF3D6 35% 38%,#0C5E66 39% 54%,#FFF3D6 55% 58%,#F28C28 59% 72%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 73%);opacity:.9}
.swing{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:64%;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:translateX(-50%);animation:oonjal 4.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.swing img{width:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 20px rgba(90,30,5,.35))}
@keyframes oonjal{from{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3.2deg)}to{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(3.2deg)}}
.room .lns .ln img{animation-duration:5s}
.note-txt{max-width:32ch;font-size:1.28rem;line-height:1.45;color:#4A0C26}
.sign{font-style:italic;font-weight:600;font-size:2rem;color:#7A0E45}

/* 6 · rsvp: the lotus opens */
.rsvp-sec{background:radial-gradient(110% 70% at 50% 18%,#4A2486 0%,#2A1458 45%,#170B38 100%);overflow:hidden}
.rsvp-sec .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.lotus{position:relative;width:min(84%,340px);aspect-ratio:1/.8;margin:4px auto 0;--o:0}
.lotus .pool{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:6%;width:96%;aspect-ratio:4/1;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,190,90,calc(.15 + var(--o) * .4)),rgba(255,140,60,0) 70%)}
.pt{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:20%;width:29%;margin-left:-14.5%;transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:rotate(calc((var(--c) + (var(--t) - var(--c)) * var(--o)) * 1deg));transition:transform .12s linear}
.pt img{width:100%}
.pt.back img{filter:brightness(.82) saturate(1.1)}
.pt.front{width:23%;margin-left:-11.5%;bottom:19%}
.diya{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:17%;width:31%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(calc((1 - var(--o)) * 26%)) scale(calc(.7 + var(--o) * .3));opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--o) * 1.6 - .2),1);transform-origin:50% 100%}
.diya img{width:100%}
.diya::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:6%;width:150%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,226,150,.85),rgba(255,170,60,.25) 40%,rgba(255,140,40,0) 70%);animation:flick 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes flick{0%{opacity:.75;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.95)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06)}}
.rsvp{width:100%;max-width:440px;display:grid;gap:18px;text-align:left;background:#FFF8EC;color:var(--ink);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 18px;font-family:var(--f-ui);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6);border:1px solid rgba(242,196,107,.6)}
.q{display:grid;gap:8px;border:0;margin:0;padding:0;min-width:0}
